$ echo one > /tmp/f; echo two >> /tmp/f; cat /tmp/f
one
two
$ echo replaced > /tmp/f; cat /tmp/f
replaced
$ cat < /tmp/f
replaced
$ wc -l <<< "a line"
1
$ nosuchcmd 2> /tmp/err; cat /tmp/err
nosuchcmd: command not found
$ nosuchcmd &> /tmp/all; cat /tmp/all
nosuchcmd: command not found
$ ls /tmp/f /nope > /tmp/out 2>&1; cat /tmp/out
ls: cannot access '/nope': No such file or directory
/tmp/f
$ echo hidden > /dev/null
$ nosuchcmd 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?
status=127
$ echo x > /nope/dir/file
-bash: /nope/dir/file: No such file or directory
[exit 1]
$ cat < /nope
-bash: /nope: No such file or directory
[exit 1]
$ echo x > $EMPTY
-bash: $EMPTY: ambiguous redirect
[exit 1]

@user admin
$ echo x > /etc/hostname
-bash: /etc/hostname: Permission denied
[exit 1]
$ echo x > ~/mine; cat ~/mine
x
